title: play_action_event
description: The active player plays an action event during an action window and pays its cost (`card_cost`); the event goes to the discard pile of its owner. From their hand, or from elsewhere when a card allows it (Kyuden Isawa, Kunshu, Artisan Academy…): an event of a hand, a conflict deck (a card looked at) or a conflict discard pile, of any player. The player resolves its effects with other actions, then ends their action (`end_resolution`), which ends their opportunity to act. Interrupt and reaction events are played with `play_interrupt_event` and `play_reaction_event`.

card_id.description: Action event played: in a hand, a conflict deck or a conflict discard pile.
